intro: Everything is processed on your phone. Nothing is sent out.

accessibility.title: Read offers
accessibility.description: To evaluate offers from Uber, 99, and inDrive. Android calls this accessibility.

howTo.title: How to turn on reading
howTo.step1: 1. Find Offer Copilot and turn on the first option. Leave the shortcut off.
howTo.step2: 2. Android warns about full control. It's the standard warning for this permission: the app reads the screen and doesn't tap anything for you.
howTo.step3: 3. If the option is blocked, open the app details, tap the three dots, and allow restricted settings.

overlay.title: Display over other apps
overlay.description: So the timer shows up while you use Uber or 99.

location.title: Location
location.description_km: To track your shift's kilometers by GPS. Choose to allow while using the app.
location.description_mi: To track your shift's miles by GPS. Choose to allow while using the app.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: For maintenance reminders and to check offers later.
